questions.question: The Yamuna does not pass through which of the following states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Yamuna River:**

__
 
• The Yamuna River is **one of the major tributaries of the Ganges in Northern India.**
 
• It forms an **integral part of the Yamuna-Ganga Plain**, one of the world's most extensive alluvial plains.
 
• **Source:** It has its source in the **Yamunotri Glacier at an elevation of 6,387 meters** on the southwestern sides of Banderpooch crests in the lower Himalayan ranges.
 
• **Basin**: It meets the Ganges at the Sangam (where Kumbh mela is held) in Prayagraj, **Uttar Pradesh after flowing through Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana and Delhi.**
 
• The **1,376 km long Yamuna** flows solely through India, crossing three states: **Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh and Haryana.**
 
• **Important Dam:** Lakhwar-Vyasi Dam (Uttarakhand), Tajewala Barrage Dam (Haryana) etc.
 
• **Important Tributaries: **Chambal, Sindh, Betwa and Ken.
 
• **Near Prayagraj (Allahabad), after a course of about 855 miles (1,376 km), the Yamuna joins the Ganges (Ganga) River.**
 
• The confluence of the two rivers is an especially **sacred place to Hindus** and is the site of annual festivals as well as the **Kumbh Mela, which is held every 12 years.**

questions.question: Which of the following is **not **the feature of the Nagara style of temple architecture?

options.text: The garbhagriha is always located directly under the tallest tower.
It is placed on a high platform accessed by stairs.
Shikharas rise high, upward in a curved fashion.
The most prominent element is the Gopuram.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The most prominent element is the Gopuram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The popularity of** Nagara-style temple architecture** increased in **Northern India.**
 
• An whole temple is frequently constructed in North India on a** stone platform that is reached by steps.**
 
• Usually, there are no** elaborate boundary walls or entrances.**
 
• Always, the** tallest tower** is directly below the **garbhagriha.**
 
• On Shikhara, there is a **Kalash or Amalaka installation.**
 
• **Sun Temple in Konark, Sun Temple in Modhera, Gujarat, and Ossian Temple in Gujarat **are examples of Nagara-style temples in India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gopuram **is a feature of** Dravidian style of architecture.**
 
• A **compound wall **encloses the Dravida temple.
 
• A **Gopuram, or entrance doorway**, is located in the **middle of the front wall**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e4bbc8ae0c54e17f8014903b7542684863464a53d6ac79a0eb7c6864b35b7c0.png]

questions.question: In which city did Indian archer Payal Nag win a historic gold medal at the World Para Archery Series Final in April 2026, becoming the world’s first quadruple amputee to do so?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangkok**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian archer Payal Nag, a quadruple amputee, achieved a historic gold medal at the World Para Archery Series Final in Bangkok on April 4, 2026.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Event Location: The historic victory took place in Bangkok, Thailand, during the World Para Archery Series Final.
 
• Opponent: Payal Nag defeated her idol and fellow Indian archer Sheetal Devi with a score of 139-136 in the final.
 
• Debut Success: This was Payal's debut senior international event, marking a significant milestone in para sports history.
 
• Unique Status: She is recognized as the world's first quadruple amputee (limbless) archer to compete and win at this level.
 
• Comparison of Options: While Jaipur was the site of the 2025 Para Archery Nationals and Katra is where her academy is located, Bangkok is specifically cited in the news as the venue for her 2026 World Series gold medal win.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Background: Payal Nag is an 18-year-old from Odisha’s Balangir district. She lost all four limbs in an electrocution accident at the age of eight.
 
• Training: She was trained by coach Kuldeep Kumar Vedwan at the Maata Vaishno Devi Shrine Archery Academy in Katra.
 
• Shooting Technique: Unlike Sheetal Devi who uses her feet, Payal uses a custom prosthetic arm to stabilize the bow and draws it using her shoulder, mouth, and a special trigger mechanism.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• Payal Nag's journey from a rural village in Odisha to the international podium is considered a testament to willpower and self-belief.
 
• Her coach, Kuldeep Vedwan, emphasized that their success is a result of belief and hard work rather than just resources.
 
• The victory is seen as a precursor to her potential participation in the Paralympics.

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the extension of Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana-III (PMGSY-III), as approved in April 2026, is INCORRECT?

options.text: The scheme has been extended beyond March 2025 and will now continue up to March 2028.
The revised outlay of the scheme is Rs. 83,977 crore, increased from the original outlay of Rs. 80,250 crore.
The timeline for the completion of bridges in hilly areas has been extended until March 2029.
The extension allows for the completion of roads and bridges in plain areas until March 2027.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The extension allows for the completion of roads and bridges in plain areas until March 2027.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister **Shri Narendra Modi**, has approved the continuation of **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana-III (PMGSY-III)** beyond **March 2025** until **March 2028**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct:** The Cabinet gave approval for the extension of the **PMGSY-III** scheme beyond its original deadline to continue up to **March 2028**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

questions.question: Which of the following is included in the estimation of National Income?

options.text: Expenditure incurred by a household on goods and services
Contribution towards social security scheme by an employee
Steel purchased by a car manufacturing company

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Expenditure incurred by a household on goods and services. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **National Income:**

 
 
• It is the total value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders in a specific period. It includes all the income generated from the production of goods and services, including employee compensation, business profits, rental income, and interest income.
 
 
 
• **Household expenditure on goods and services** is a component of the aggregate demand, which contributes to the production of goods and services, and therefore, it is included in the estimation of National Income.
 
• **Sugar purchased by a restaurant and Steel purchased by a car manufacturing company** is intermediate goods that are used in the production of final goods and services. Only the value of final goods and services is included in the estimation of National Income.
 
• **Contribution towards the social security scheme by an employee** is not included in the estimation of National Income. It is a transfer payment made by the employee to the government to finance social welfare programs and is not a part of the production of goods and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• National income estimates are used to measure the overall **economic activity of a country over a specific period**, usually a year.
 
• The most commonly used measures of national income are **Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Gross National Product (GNP), and Net National Product (NNP)**.
 
• GDP measures the total value of all goods and services produced within a country's borders, regardless of the nationality of the producer, while GNP measures the total value of all goods and services produced by the citizens of a country, regardless of their location.
 
• NNP adjusts the GDP or GNP figure by deducting the depreciation of capital assets used in production, to arrive at a more accurate measure of a country's economic output.
 
• **National income estimates **provide policymakers with important information about the state of the economy and can be used to guide economic policy decisions.
 
• **National income estimates **can also be used to compare the economic performance of different countries or regions, as well as to track changes in the economy over time.
 
• **National income estimates** are compiled by national statistical agencies, using data from a variety of sources, including surveys of businesses and households, tax records, and administrative records.

questions.question: _________ is the minimum age for holding office in the Lok Sabha.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**25 years**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **25 years**__ is the minimum age for holding office in the Lok Sabha.

 __
 
• **​Article 84 (b) of the Constitution of India provides the minimum age for becoming a candidate for the Lok Sabha election.**
 
• The person should not be a proclaimed criminal and his/her name should be in the electoral rolls of the country.
 
• The term of the members of Lok Sabha is a maximum of 5 years.
 
• The members of the Lok Sabha are directly elected by the citizens of India by the law of universal suffrage that means each and every person above the age of 18 years has the right to vote for the suitable candidate.
 
• Any additional qualifications shall be prescribed by Parliament by law.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Parliament of India consists of three parts viz, the President, the Council of States and the House of the People.
 
• **Articles 79 to 122 in Part V of the Constitution deal with the organization, composition, duration, officers, procedures, privileges, powers and so on of the Parliament. **
 
• **In Rajya Sabha, the minimum age for holding office is 30 years**.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding **Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar**, whose birth anniversary was recently observed:

**Statement 1:** He founded the **Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha** and led the **Mahad Satyagraha** in **1927** to fight against social injustice.

**Statement 2:** He served as the **Chairman of the Drafting Committee** of the Constitution and was posthumously awarded the **Bharat Ratna** in **1949**.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1 only**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The nation, including **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh**, paid tribute to **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar** on his **135th birth anniversary** on **April 14**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1 is correct:** Returning to India in **1923**, Dr. Ambedkar dedicated his life to fighting social injustice. He founded the **Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha** to promote education and uplift marginalized communities. He also led historic movements like the **Mahad Satyagraha (1927)** and the **Kalaram Temple Entry Movement (1930)**.
 
• **Statement 2 is incorrect:** While it is true that he was the **Chairman of the Drafting Committee** of the Constitution, he was posthumously awarded the **Bharat Ratna** in **1990**, not in **1949** (which was the year the Constitution was adopted).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Dr. Ambedkar was born on **April 14, 1891**, in **Mhow, Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• He pursued higher education at **Columbia University** and the **London School of Economics**, becoming a distinguished economist and jurist.
 
• His notable economic works include **“The Evolution of Provincial Finance in British India”** and **“The Problem of the Rupee”**.
 
• The **Poona Pact** was a significant political agreement between **Ambedkar** and **Mahatma Gandhi** regarding reservations for Scheduled Castes.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• He was appointed **India’s first Law Minister** in the cabinet of **Jawaharlal Nehru**.
 
• His death on **December 6, 1956**, is observed annually as **Mahaparinirvan Diwas**.
 
• His final philosophical work is titled **“The Buddha and His Dhamma”**.

questions.question: This event is celebrated to mark the resurrection of Christ. Identify the event.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Easter.

 
 

 Event
 Explanation
 
 
 
 

 Easter
 - Easter is a major Christian holiday celebrating the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, as described in the New Testament of the Bible.

 - It symbolizes the triumph of life over death and holds central importance in Christian theology.

 - Observed on the first Sunday after the first full moon following the vernal equinox, usually falling between March 22 and April 25.

 - Easter Sunday marks the culmination of the season of Lent, a period of fasting, prayer, and reflection.
 
 

 Christmas
 - Christmas commemorates the birth of Jesus Christ, the central figure of Christianity.

 - Celebrated on December 25th (in most Christian traditions), it holds both religious and cultural significance.

 - The holiday includes traditions such as decorating trees, exchanging gifts, and festive gatherings.

 - It marks the incarnation of Jesus, emphasizing the belief that God became human to save humanity.
 
 

 Holy Thursday
 - Also known as Maundy Thursday, it falls on the Thursday before Easter Sunday.

 - Commemorates the Last Supper of Jesus Christ with his disciples, where he instituted the Eucharist (Holy Communion).

 - "Maundy" originates from the Latin word "mandatum," referring to Jesus' commandment to love one another.

 - Some Christian denominations practice foot washing ceremonies to symbolize humility and service, as Jesus washed his disciples' feet.
 
 

 Good Friday
 - Good Friday is observed on the Friday before Easter Sunday, commemorating the crucifixion and death of Jesus Christ.

 - It's a solemn day of reflection, fasting, and church services focusing on Jesus' sacrifice for humanity.

 - In many Christian traditions, no Mass or Communion is celebrated on Good Friday.

 - It's a day of mourning, emphasizing the somber aspect of the Easter story before the joyous celebration of the resurrection.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Managing Director (MD) and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC) effective April 7, 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vibhor Jain**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Vibhor Jain** has been promoted as the **Managing Director** and **Chief Executive Officer** of **Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC)**, effective **April 7, 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vibhor Jain**: He previously served as the **Chief Operating Officer (COO)** and has been the **acting CEO** of ONDC since **April 2025**.
 
• **Transition**: Jain took over the acting role after the former chief executive, **Thampy Koshy**, resigned in April of the previous year.
 
• **Leadership Team**: ONDC also confirmed that **Rohit Lohia** has joined as the **Chief Business Officer** and **Manoj Thakur** as the **Chief Technology Officer**.
 
• **Core Mission**: Jain highlighted his priority to deepen the value for **kisaans (farmers)**, **karigars (artisans)**, **kiranas**, **gig workers**, and **daily commuters** across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Financial Performance**: ONDC reported a **127% surge** in total revenue, reaching **Rs 33.41 crore** for the **2024-25** fiscal year, up from **Rs 14.7 crore** in the previous fiscal.
 
• **Net Loss**: The network's net loss narrowed to **Rs 147.13 crore** in FY25 from **Rs 195.6 crore** in the previous year.
 
• **Transaction Data**: Between **January 2023** and **August 2025**, the network facilitated **288 million orders** and currently hosts **167,500 retail sellers**.
 
• **Financial Services**: ONDC is introducing fees for the **financial services domain**, specifically for **mutual fund transactions** and **credit transactions**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Infrastructure Fees**: The implementation of **network infrastructure development** and service fees had been pending for **16 months** since **December 2024** before recent updates.
 
• **Retail Orders**: From **April 2024 to August 2025**, ONDC facilitated approximately **83.8 million retail orders**.
 
• **Network Nature**: ONDC is a **government-backed open e-commerce network** designed to allow interoperable connections between buyers and sellers through multiple applications.

questions.question: In which of the following sectors workers are underemployed?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the Agricultural sector.

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**The term unemployment generally refers to** individuals who are not able to get jobs** at the existing wage rate. Unemployment is broadly understood on two basis, **Rural unemployment** and Urban **unemployment.**

 
• **Rural Unemployment**- there are two major unemployment lie in the rural sector are **Disguised unemployment** and** seasonal unemployment**.

 
 
• **Disguised unemployment-** it occurs when people are **not counted as employed** even they are working, for example in the agriculture sector generally most of the members of a family work in fields but** income is counted only as an individual. **
 
• **Seasonal unemployment-** In the rural area most of people have **seasonal work **after they do not have work to do, this is the type of seasonal unemployment.
 
 
 
• **Urban employment- Industrial and frictional unemployment** lie in the urban sector.
 
 
• **Industrial unemployment-** this type of unemployment occurs due to** unnecessary urbanisation** when i**nessential** **labour supply **is available in the market.
 
• Frictional unemployment- it occurs due to a gap between two jobs. 
 
 
 
• Underemployment is a situation when a person does **get work according to his/her ability** it may be in terms of the payout he gets. It is **different from disguised unemploymen**t lies in rural areas.
